constraints: The document's id attribute values must each be unique and a valid XML name (XML validity constraint); if this is violated, the command's result is unpredictable (it returns the reference to the first matching element found).
The search always covers the whole document, regardless of which element elementRef designates.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Searches the whole XML document (regardless of elementRef's position) for the element whose id attribute equals a given value.
